However, the size and scope of this workforce can vary depending on the data source and methodology used to calculate it. The two main sources of federal workforce statistics, OMB and OPM, use different methods: OMB uses full-time equivalent (FTE) counting, while OPM uses on-board headcounts.

FTE counting calculates the number of full-time employees by dividing the total hours worked by the number of hours in a full-time workweek.
